evidence.note: Dozens of thin (~1px) light-grey spoke lines fan from tiny agent-run dots to the package mirror; the dots themselves are small thin-stroked circles.
At the small size the spokes become faint grey hairlines and the dots shrink to a few pixels; the 'Package mirror' label is partly hidden and greyed behind stacked document icons.
'PUBLIC INTERNET' label and globe outline are very pale grey on white, low contrast; at 1288x598 the label is small and barely legible.
Title, timeline text and quote card are large and high contrast; no texture or grain anywhere.

rationale: Text blocks and cards are generous, but the core diagram is built from many 1px grey hairlines and tiny thin-stroked dots, exactly what compression erases. The pale 'PUBLIC INTERNET' label adds small faint text, worse at the small viewer size. That matches the fail descriptor.
